# Vendored libraries

Served from this folder so the site makes no runtime CDN requests.

| File | Package | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `d3.min.js` | d3 | 7.9.0 | ISC | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7/dist/d3.min.js |
| `topojson-client.min.js` | topojson-client | 3.1.0 | ISC | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3/dist/topojson-client.min.js |
| `../geo/countries-110m.json` | world-atlas | 2.0.2 | ISC (geometry from Natural Earth, public domain) | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/countries-110m.json |

Copyright notices for d3 and topojson-client are kept in the first line of each minified file

To update, re-download the same URLs and change the versions above.
